tools.name: Hex
tools.without: Voice uses the browser's speech recognition, which is online. Install Hex to keep speech on your machine.

listing.tagline: Hold a key and speak: start a session or send a prompt with no Enter press
listing.description: Hold Ctrl+Shift+Space, speak and let go. "New session, fix the flaky test" opens the New session dialog with that prompt, and anything else goes to the session on screen as a prompt and is submitted. Kanban's New session microphone uses the same speech to text. Hex does the speech to text on your machine; without it, the browser's speech recognition does it.

screenshots.alt: Animation: the user holds Ctrl+Shift+Space and says "Hub, add a task, fix the login page redirect". Kanban's Add task dialog fills as they speak, and Enter adds the task to the board. Then "Hub, new session, fix the flaky login test and run the suite" opens the New session dialog with that prompt
screenshots.title: Words show up as you speak
screenshots.caption: "Hub, add a task" fills the Add task dialog, and "Hub, new session" opens New session with the rest as the prompt.

screenshots.alt: The Hex website: "Speak. It appears.", local voice dictation for Windows, with the Windows installer and a PowerShell install command
screenshots.title: Hex does the speech to text
screenshots.caption: Install Hex and start it once. It runs on your machine, and the hub sends it the sound while you hold the keys.
